Use the photograph to answer the question.

This photograph shows a U.S. Air Force C-54 Skymaster cargo plane flying low over a crowd of German civilians as it approaches Tempelhof Airport in Berlin during the summer of 1948.

(Photograph, 1948. U.S. Air Force.)

How did the Berlin Airlift shown in this photograph reflect the U.S. policy of containment during the early Cold War?
items.stemEs: ¿Cómo reflejó el Puente Aéreo de Berlín la política de contención de EE. UU.?

choices.text: The U.S. showed resolve against Soviet expansion without direct force
choices.textEs: EE. UU. demostró su determinación de impedir la expansión soviética sin una confrontación militar directa

choices.text: The U.S. used military force to drive Soviet troops out of the eastern sector of Berlin
choices.textEs: EE. UU. utilizó la fuerza militar para expulsar las tropas soviéticas de Berlín Oriental

choices.text: The U.S. imposed economic sanctions that forced the Soviet Union to end communism
choices.textEs: EE. UU. impuso sanciones económicas que obligaron a la Unión Soviética a poner fin al comunismo

choices.text: The U.S. negotiated a peace treaty that divided Germany into permanent zones
choices.textEs: EE. UU. negoció un tratado de paz que dividió a Alemania en zonas permanentes

items.stem:
Use the photograph to answer the question.

This photograph shows American soldiers during the Korean War, c. 1950.

(U.S. Army photograph, c. 1950. Public Domain.)

Which statement best analyzes the long-term consequences of the Korean War for U.S. foreign policy and military strategy?
items.stemEs:
Utiliza la fotografía para responder la pregunta.

Esta fotografía muestra a soldados estadounidenses durante la Guerra de Corea, c. 1950.

(Fotografía del Ejército de los Estados Unidos, c. 1950. Dominio público.)

¿Cuál enunciado analiza mejor las consecuencias a largo plazo de la Guerra de Corea para la política exterior y la estrategia militar de Estados Unidos?

choices.text: The war had no lasting consequences because it ended in a stalemate
choices.textEs: La guerra no tuvo consecuencias duraderas porque terminó en un empate

choices.text: The war established a precedent for limited wars to contain communism, expanded the permanent military establishment, and deepened Cold War alliances in Asia
choices.textEs: La guerra estableció un precedente para las guerras limitadas destinadas a contener el comunismo, amplió el establecimiento militar permanente y profundizó las alianzas de la Guerra Fría en Asia

choices.text: The war resulted in the reunification of Korea and permanent peace in the region
choices.textEs: La guerra resultó en la reunificación de Corea y la paz permanente en la región

choices.text: The Korean War convinced the United States to abandon the containment policy in favor of isolationism
choices.textEs: La Guerra de Corea convenció a Estados Unidos de abandonar la política de contención a favor del aislacionismo

This photograph shows soldiers of the U.S. Army's 101st Airborne Division escorting African American students into Little Rock Central High School in Arkansas in September 1957. President Eisenhower deployed federal troops after Arkansas Governor Orval Faubus used the state National Guard to block the students' entry.

(Photograph, September 1957. U.S. Army.)

Why did President Eisenhower send federal troops to Little Rock, Arkansas, as shown in this photograph?
items.stemEs: ¿Por qué el presidente Eisenhower envió tropas federales a Little Rock?

choices.text: To enforce the Brown v. Board ruling and ensure the desegregation of Central High School
To suppress a labor strike that had shut down the city's schools
To implement the Civil Rights Act of 1957, which required integrated schools
To protect the school from a foreign military threat during the Cold War
